title: Matrix-valued closure beyond the second Schur moment
objective: Construct or rule out a dimension-uniform matrix state that controls the third and higher Bellman Schur-loss lifts and proves the half-depth mu/2 certificate.
acceptance_checks: Reproduces the exact R2-not-less-than-C-R1 and m^3 scalarization barriers.
Does not apply Jensen in the wrong direction to the parallel sum.
Tests both simple-null and high-nullity boundary geometries.
A claimed finite basis is shown closed under an actual Bellman lift.
